column3: “Aram … Moab … people of Ammon” is rendered “Arameans … Moabites … Ammonites.”
“On the mouth of the LORD” is rendered “at the command of the LORD,” and “from His face” as “from His sight.”
The written Hebrew reads “went up” (singular), the reading tradition “they went up.”
“Officials … court officials” is rendered “captains … officials,” and “took him” as “took him captive.”
“Articles” is rendered “vessels,” and “for the temple” as “in the temple.”
“Officials” is rendered “captains,” and “mighty men of strength” as “mighty men of valor.”
“Court officials” is rendered “officials,” and “leaders” as “leading men.”
“Men of strength” is rendered “men of valor,” and “warriors, makers of war” as “strong and fit for war.”
“On the anger” is rendered “through the anger,” and “from His face” as “from His presence.”
